description: Veterinary Medicine explores animal health careers: the many kinds of veterinary practice, the training to become a veterinarian or veterinary technician, the human–animal bond, time with a veterinarian, and career paths.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. The 2026 update removed a report-writing requirement and revised the careers requirement, so the numbering shown here should be confirmed against the official list.
